name: Flawless Auto Detailing Hollywood
address: 1052 N Federal Hwy, Hollywood, FL 33020, United States
website_check: Google Maps listing shows 'Add website' (no website button, only a Calendly booking link under the Book action). flawlessautodetailing.com and glosshausauto.com do not resolve to this business (flawlessautodetailing.com is a parked GoDaddy for-sale page, unrelated to this Hollywood FL business; glosshausauto.com does not resolve). No Instagram/Facebook profile found for this exact business after search.
hours: Open 24 hours (mobile detailing, comes to the customer's location)
booking_channel: https://calendly.com/glosshausauto/full-detail (Calendly scheduling page linked from the Google Business Profile's Book button; operates under the booking name 'Gloss Haus', one service listed: Full Detail, 3h 30min, no public price)

source_of_data.discovery: python3 scripts/maps_discover.py --niche "handyman" ... ; python3.13-equivalent live search "auto detailing service" in "Hollywood, FL"
source_of_data.detail: node scripts/gmaps_detail.js <mapsUrl> -> rating 5.0, reviews 31, phone, address, hours Open 24 hours, website null, calendly.com link in raw snippet
source_of_data.booking_link: node script extracting <a href> containing 'calendly' from the rendered Maps place page -> https://calendly.com/glosshausauto/full-detail ; rendered that page with Playwright -> service 'Full Detail', 3h 30min, text confirm, no price shown
source_of_data.reviews: node scripts/gmaps_reviews.js <mapsUrl> 10 -> 3 unique verbatim 5-star reviews after de-dup
source_of_data.photos: node scripts/gmaps_photocycle.js <mapsUrl> 15 -> 11 unique Google Maps photos, visually curated one by one with the Read tool, 9 kept (2 dropped: exact duplicate and a shadow-silhouette shot of the photographer)

reviews_verbatim.author: Mariana Torres Forero
reviews_verbatim.text: Hey these guys really do good work, I promise!

reviews_verbatim.author: Juan Cevallos
reviews_verbatim.text: They have the best car detailing in town, they do excellent work and the customer service is really good too. Definitely coming back!
